Ways to serve

Not everything in the life of the parish is an organisation with a roster. Flowers for a feast, a Sunday coffee hour, a meal taken to a household that needs one, prosphora for the Divine Liturgy, a hand at the Greek Festival — each of these is a way to serve without joining anything.

If that is nearer to what you have to offer, Get Involved sets out each of them, and none of them asks you to already know how.
